name: CinemaVault
description: Netflix-style media discovery with Seerr integration
overview: Transform Jellyfin into a Netflix/Disney+ experience with hero banners, carousels, and Seerr integration

versions.changelog:
Initial release — Complete Netflix-style UI with Seerr integration

🎬 Features:
- Hero banner with rotating featured content
- Horizontal scrolling carousels (Netflix-style)
- Seerr/Jellyseerr integration for content discovery
- Radarr/Sonarr integration for download management
- Real-time request status tracking
- Personal watchlist management
- Responsive design with mobile support
- Dark theme with customizable accent colors
- Request management system
- Content details modal with trailers
- Advanced search functionality
- User profile and settings pages

🔧 Technical:
- Built for Jellyfin 10.11.x
- .NET 9 runtime
- Vanilla JavaScript (no frameworks)
- CSS Grid and Flexbox layouts
- Intersection Observer for lazy loading
- Service worker for caching
- Responsive design patterns

🐛 Known Issues:
- CSS line-clamp warnings in older browsers (cosmetic only)
- Requires modern browser for full functionality
